    {"decision_id":"36fd3dc6ad672b1b652c-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"sudo 範例用於啟動互動式 shell，未示範在本機檔案末尾追加文字。","evidence":"Shell Shell This executable can spawn an interactive system shell."}
